description: A Hyperliquid perp's mark price against its oracle price over time, with the premium in basis points ((mark / oracle - 1) x 10,000) per bucket and a summary (latest, mean, min, max). On HIP-3 stock, index and commodity perps such as xyz:NVDA-PERP, xyz:GOLD-PERP or xyz:SP500-PERP the oracle follows the underlying, so this shows how far the perp trades from what it tracks, weekends included. Default 1h buckets over the last 7 days. For funding payments use get_funding_rates.

days.description: How many days back (default 7; limited by your key's history window)

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

name: get_premium

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

summary.description: Premium over the window, in basis points

title: Mark against oracle premium
